corrected_content.problem: Simplify the trigonometric expression $\sin^{2} x\cos^{3} x + \sin^{4} x\cos x$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Factor and apply the Pythagorean identity:
$$\sin^2x\cos^3x+\sin^4x\cos x=\sin^2x\cos x(\cos^2x+\sin^2x)=\sin^2x\cos x.$$
